A '''poster''' was put up in the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] cell that [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] shared in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]],<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>
in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of a [[Unidentified Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]] commandeered by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] on [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]],<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref> and on an [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] piloted by [[Jay Igno/Legends|Jay Igno]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The motif showed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]] and two [[Arbozoic tree/Legends|arbozoic trees]],<ref name="Orders" /> a [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the planet.<ref name="Mercy">{{TCW|Mercy Mission (episode)}}</ref> The caption, which was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], ended in "eena", presumably "[[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]],"<ref name="Orders" /> one of the planet's native species.<ref name="Mercy" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Painting/Legends|poster]] first appears in [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]]'s cell in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Deception]]," but most of it is obscured by Eval's body.<ref name="Deception" /> It re-appears in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of a [[Unidentified Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]] commandeered by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] in the episode "[[Brothers (episode)|Brothers]]." It is best seen in the shot where the door to the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] slams shut after Savage throws out the [[Unidentified Sakiyan cargo hauler/Legends|Sakiyan cargo hauler]]. However, the lighting is so dim that the poster is completely illegible, and you can only the silhouette of the motif.<ref name="Brothers" /> It is seen in the cockpit again in "[[Revenge (episode)|Revenge]]," under the same lighting conditions.<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref> The poster is seen clearly for the first time on [[Jay Igno/Legends|Jay Igno]]'s [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] in the episode "[[Orders (episode)|Orders]]."<ref name="Orders" />
